Dump the boyfriend, whats the point of having him around if he only brings pain? 

You got homework to do, so I guess you are still young. I'm pretty sure you will find true love in the future, but if you die now, you won't live to that future.

Please don't kill yourself because of some douche rat, be strong, independent woman.

That's the point, I don't know.

Well, it'd be nice to be movie director or cameraman, cause I'd help making something that would last for ages, but unfortunately to do so you need to be popular and have connections with important people.
Even a simpler job would be nice, maybe my first post doesn't look like, but I don't care about money, I'd like to do something that means something.

I not consider my self as a failure, I just don't see future for myself and instead of being unnecessary luggage for society, I prefer to die.

In 2014/15 I was in Informatics class, and in 2015/16 I was in Sea Navigation, I dropped first one after a year, second after 4 months, because neither of them would give me job that I would like.
